scope: Pre-AC1021 DXF DIMSTYLE DIMFXLON group-290 output

evidence.format_crosswalk: The project DIMSTYLE variable descriptor maps group 290 to DIMFXLON with minimum revision AC1021. ODA DWG v5.4.1 identifies DIMFXLON as R2007+; Autodesk documents the system-variable meaning and initial value 0. ezdxf maps DIMFXLON to DXF group 290 and identifies it among variables not documented in Autodesk's DXF reference.

references.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files
ezdxf DIMSTYLE internals
references.observation: Maps DIMFXLON to group 290 and marks it as undocumented in Autodesk's DXF Reference; independent peer evidence, not Autodesk authority.

evidence.code: dxfRW::writeDimstyle now refuses pre-AC1021 output when the typed dimfxlon field or a dynamic group-290 override enables fixed-length extension lines. The default off value remains omitted.
evidence.control: libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation generates typed and dynamic enabled cases and verifies atomic refusal plus same-writer retry after restoring off in ASCII and Binary AC1018; it also checks clean ASCII output contains no DIMSTYLE group 290.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated controls write only to the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: The group-290 DXF projection is corroborated by ezdxf and the existing project descriptor; Autodesk's published DIMSTYLE table does not list it.
This does not qualify other unofficial DIMSTYLE variables or native dimension rendering semantics.
